Without a margin each depletion deadline is served by the cheapest slot before it, whatever the energy is worth when it is used.
With a margin of 0.01 or 0.04 the same night plans 0 kWh (cheaper_to_import 3.59 kWh): no hour before sunrise repays a charge.
NOW: round-trip losses always count in Dynamic Pricing and an unset margin means losses only, so this night books 0 kWh (cheaper_to_import), the same as a margin of 0.01.
